overclaims: Several central features had clear precedents: contextual writing, AI photo editing, generated stickers, and retrieval across personal services.
checks.note: Excerpt, criteria, unresolved outcome and citations all match. The opening rationale sentence goes beyond the evidence. e1 lists writing, audio, images, personal context and cross-app actions, and its quoted text covers audio transcription and Image Playground generation. Nothing shows Apple announced AI photo editing as a central feature, so Samsung's editing tools (e3) are not a shown precedent for an Apple feature. 'Clear precedents' also overstates e4 and e5, whose own explanations say equivalence was not established. Fix: drop photo editing or cite Apple's editing feature, and soften 'clear'.

The excerpt is an unaltered clause in Zitron's words and is not misleading. Adding 'AI' to the proposition fits the context. The rationale matches the evidence: Yahoo Finance's 15 May 2024 report of Goldman's 'premier AI innovator' view after I/O, and the 26 Feb Reuters report of a 3.5% drop given as context. It clearly says this does not show most investors were convinced, and the limitations note it relies on reporting and does not attribute the stock moves to AI alone. The contradicted outcome matches the agreed reviews. Excerpts, publishers, dates and relations match.
